datasets.name: Landslide Hazard Score (POA)

quality.temporalCoverage: Static terrain layers (Copernicus GLO-30 DEM slope, MERIT Hydro HAND, SoilGrids clay); climate layer CHIRPS R90p long-run climatology; vegetation MODIS NDVI P10 DJF 2015–2024; land cover Dynamic World mode 2023.
quality.accuracy: Weighted ensemble of five normalized terrain and climate layers on a 90 m grid. Formula: H = clamp01(0.45×slope_risk + 0.20×precip_risk×slope_risk + 0.15×low_cohesion×slope_risk + 0.10×lack_of_veg×slope_risk + 0.10×hand_factor×slope_risk) ± Dynamic World land cover modifier. Slope activation gate: slope < 15° → H = 0.
quality.limitations: Susceptibility index only — not failure probability or event frequency. CHIRPS R90p at ~5 km; nearest-neighbour resampled to 90 m. Not validated against CEMADEN or INMET historical landslide inventory. Static: does not capture time-varying antecedent moisture or seasonal vegetation dynamics.

datasets.description: OEF landslide susceptibility index (0–1) for Porto Alegre on a 90 m grid. Ensemble of Copernicus GLO-30 slope, CHIRPS R90p climatology, SoilGrids clay %, MODIS NDVI P10 (DJF 2015–2024), and MERIT Hydro HAND, with Dynamic World land cover modifier. Slope < 15° gates all components to zero. Methodology in `models/landslide_hazard/model_card.md`. Computed by `transformation/landslide_hazard/landslide_hazard_score.ipynb` (`export LANDSLIDES_SITE=porto_alegre`).

datasets.name: Landslide Risk Score H×E×V (POA)

quality.temporalCoverage: Static composite: landslide hazard (terrain + CHIRPS R90p climatology + MODIS DJF 2015–2024) combined with shared E/V from Censo 2022.
quality.accuracy: R = (H × E × V)^(1/3) on 90 m cells where all three components are finite. E and V are bairro-level attributes burned onto the 90 m hazard grid (resolution-agnostic rasterization — same polygon data as flood/heat, different grid).
quality.limitations: Screening-level composite; E/V constant per bairro; not IPCC full risk or casualty modeling. Non-zero risk only appears on slopes ≥ 15° within inhabited bairros. Area denominator in E includes parks, water bodies, and non-residential land.
